 Are you getting Social Security payments on Oct. 21 or 30? SSDI averages $1,630, while SSI can reach $994— which check is yours this month?
 SECTIONS Are you getting Social Security payments on Oct. 21 or 30? SSDI averages $1,630, while SSI can reach $994— which check is yours this month? By Piyush Shukla , Global Desk Last Updated: Oct 20, 2026, 10:00:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Social Security recipients are preparing for another round of monthly payments, with the next scheduled deposits due on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. October also brings a calendar change for people receiving Supplemental Security Income (SSI). The November SSI payment will arrive on October 30 because November 1 falls on a Sunday.
 Agencies Social Security Payments: Are You Getting SSDI on October 21 or SSI on October 30? Two dates matter for Americans waiting for their Social Security money this week and next week. Wednesday, October 21, is the next scheduled payment date for beneficiaries whose birthdays fall between the 11th and 20th under the standard Social Security schedule. Friday, October 30 is also important but for a different reason. Eligible Supplemental Security Income (SSI) recipients will receive their November payment early.
 The amounts also differ. The Social Security Administration (SSA) estimates that the average monthly benefit for disabled workers is about $1,630 in 2026. The maximum federal SSI payment is $994 a month for an eligible individual.
 Is your Social Security payment due on October 21, and how much could you receive?
The October 21 payment is intended for beneficiaries covered by the standard Wednesday schedule whose relevant birthday falls between the 11th and 20th of the month. This includes eligible Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) recipients, along with retirement and survivor benefit recipients covered by the same rules. 
For most people who began receiving Social Security under the system introduced in May 1997, payments are organised around three Wednesdays each month. Those born between the 1st and 10th generally receive their money on the second Wednesday. People in the 11th-to-20th group are paid on the third Wednesday, while those born between the 21st and 31st usually receive their payment on the fourth Wednesday.
 For October 2026, the remaining standard payment dates are: 
 Live Events
 Wednesday, October 21: Birthdays from the 11th through the 20th.
 Wednesday, October 28: Birthdays from the 21st through the 31st.
 Beneficiaries whose birthdays fall between the 1st and 10th were generally scheduled to receive their October payment on October 14.
 People who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 generally receive their payment on the third of the month. Those receiving both Social Security and SSI also normally receive Social Security on the third and SSI on the first. Since October 3 falls on a Saturday, the October Social Security payment for this group was scheduled for Friday, October 2.
 Why is SSI paying up to $994 on October 30, and is it extra money?
SSI follows a separate calendar. It provides financial assistance to eligible people who have limited income and resources and are aged 65 or older, blind or disabled. Unlike the standard Social Security Wednesday schedule, SSI payments are normally issued on the first day of each month.
The October SSI payment was scheduled for Thursday, October 1. The next payment will arrive on Friday, October 30, because November 1 falls on a Sunday. The SSA moves payments forward when the usual payment date falls on a weekend or federal holiday.
This means eligible SSI recipients will see two deposits in October. The first covers October, while the second covers November. The October 30 deposit is not a bonus or an extra monthly benefit. It is November's payment arriving one day earlier than the calendar month begins.
The maximum federal SSI payment for 2026 is $994 per month for an eligible individual and $1,491 for an eligible couple in which both qualify. However, not everyone receives the maximum. Income, living arrangements and other circumstances can reduce the amount payable. Some states also provide additional payments.
The same calendar adjustment affects later payments. The December SSI payment is scheduled for Tuesday, December 1, while the January 2027 payment is due on Thursday, December 31, because January 1 is a federal holiday.
 What should you do if your Social Security payment is missing or the amount is different?
A payment date in the official calendar does not guarantee that every recipient will see the money in their bank account at the same moment. The amount and timing depend on the person's benefit category and individual payment arrangements.
If your payment is not visible on the expected date, first check your bank or financial institution to see whether the deposit is still being processed. The SSA advises recipients to allow three additional mailing days before contacting the agency about a payment that has not arrived.
If the money is still missing, contact the Social Security Administration at 1-800-772-1213 or visit a local Social Security office. You can also sign in to your my Social Security account to review available benefit and payment information.
